Hi Priya and Samir,

Thanks again for the time today — useful convo and good alignment on goals for the POC. Per our notes I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to capture scope, owners and target dates so we can move toward a confirmed kickoff. High-level recap below: 

- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for FinEdge document search and summarization (latency < 250ms target for 95th pct under eval load).
- Success criteria: 3 sample jobs completed with target latency, accuracy on benchmark prompts > 78% relative to your in-house baseline, and a proposed cost estimate within the committed budget envelope.
- Deliverables in MAP: tech scope, data access requirements, evaluation dataset, timeline, and rollback criteria.

What I need from you to lock things in: 
1) Confirm owners for each MAP line item (business lead, technical owner, procurement contact).
2) Confirm target dates in the timeline (I put tentative dates in the sheet).
3) Any constraints on data access (VPN, sample size, PII handling) that would affect schedule.

If it helps, I can schedule a 15-minute alignment call — available Thursday 10/21 10:00-10:30am PT or Friday 10/22 9:00-9:30am PT.
